_meta.description: Rule table for the fertilizer estimator. Nutrient doses are N, P2O5 and K2O in kg per hectare.
_meta.status: APPROXIMATE general values for Indian conditions. NOT verified against a specific publication.
_meta.source: TO BE VERIFIED: replace the crop doses and soil-test thresholds with figures from your State Agricultural University / ICAR package of practices (or Soil Health Card guidelines) and cite them in your report.
_meta.how_it_works: Standard crop dose x soil-test adjustment (low/medium/high) -> nutrient target -> fertilizer kg using nutrient content of each product.
